C0515.title: SOHO router compromise leads to DNS hijacking and adversary-in-the-middle attacks
C0515.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence assesses that attackers compromised SOHO routers to perform DNS hijacking, potentially enabling large-scale adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) attacks. Such operations may involve active network traffic interception, consistent with techniques used to analyze HTTP/HTTPS requests through man-in-the-middle methods.
